subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should OpenClaw accept runtime invalidation for legacy no-code, no-pluginId diagnostics with missing absolute sources, or should that cleanup live in doctor/migration instead?
rationale: The explicit marker path follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy fallback intentionally changes upgraded persisted-state behavior and needs owner acceptance beyond ordinary CI.

options.title: Accept runtime invalidation after proof
options.body: Require redacted latest-head proof for the legacy SQLite row, then land the runtime rederive path as the upgrade behavior.

options.title: Move legacy cleanup to doctor/migration
options.body: Keep the explicit code marker and schema fix but remove or redesign the runtime legacy fallback so persisted-state repair is migration-owned.

options.title: Accept source and tests only
options.body: Maintainers can waive additional real behavior proof, but that explicitly accepts the persisted-state upgrade risk on source and test evidence alone.

recommendation.title: Accept runtime invalidation after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted latest-head proof for the legacy SQLite row, then land the runtime rederive path as the upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the predecessor direction that shaped this PR and have recent ownership signals in the touched plugin registry/discovery area.
